ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is an α,β-unsaturated aldehyde structure, with the terminal carbon-carbon double bond connected to the aldehyde group, namely CH2=CH-CHO; in the aldehyde group, C=O and the aldehydic hydrogen H can be seen. On the right side is a benzene ring connected to NH2, namely aniline, and a lone pair of electrons is also drawn on the nitrogen. H+ is also separately marked above in the figure. There are several curved arrows in the figure, but the question requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: After ignoring the arrows, no bonds are formed or broken according to the electron-flow arrows, so this structure should be written as SMILES according to three unconnected components: the left-side enal is C=CC=O, the right-side aniline is Nc1ccccc1, and the proton is [H+]. Connect disconnected components with dots to obtain C=CC=O.Nc1ccccc1.[H+].

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the left molecule as an enal, specifically CH2=CH-CHO, because it has a terminal alkene connected to an aldehyde carbonyl bearing H; identify the right molecule as aniline, H2N-phenyl; note the standalone H+ symbol. Follow the text instruction to ignore the curved arrows, so do not create or break bonds from the electron-flow annotations. Convert each disconnected component to SMILES and join with dot separators, yielding C=CC=O.Nc1ccccc1.[H+].
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个α,β-不饱和醛结构，末端碳碳双键连接到醛基，即 CH2=CH-CHO；醛基中可见 C=O 和醛氢 H。右侧是一个苯环连接到 NH2，即苯胺，氮上还画有孤对电子。图中上方还单独标出 H+。图中存在若干弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：忽略箭头后，不根据电子流箭头形成或断裂任何键，因此该结构应按三个未连接组分书写 SMILES：左侧烯醛为 C=CC=O，右侧苯胺为 Nc1ccccc1，质子为 [H+]。用点号连接 disconnected components，得到 C=CC=O.Nc1ccccc1.[H+]。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the depicted static atoms and bonds while ignoring all curved arrows: an alpha,beta-unsaturated aldehyde fragment with C=C-C(=O)H, a separate aniline molecule shown as H2N attached to a benzene ring, and a separate proton label H+ near the carbonyl oxygen.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and that arrows must be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard SMILES conventions: disconnected species are separated by dots; acrolein/propenal can be written as C=CC=O; aniline as Nc1ccccc1; a proton as [H+]. Curved arrows indicate electron flow and are not included in the molecular graph.
